title: SparkPen Interactive Classroom Teacher Guide
author: Dr. Elena Vance
description: Complete classroom implementation guide covering Bluetooth sync, real-time handwriting digitization, and interactive quiz integration.
content:
# SparkPen Interactive Classroom Teacher Guide (v2.4)

## Overview
The SparkPen enables teachers and students to digitize whiteboards and notebooks seamlessly.

### Quick Start Steps:
1. Ensure the SparkPen Charging Station LED shows solid green.
2. Tap the pen nib on the calibration card.
3. Open EcoSpark Classroom App on your tablet or projector.
4. Real-time vector strokes will appear with less than 12ms latency.

title: AirSpark Sensor Hub Circuit Schematics Rev C
author: Marcus Brody
description: Electrical engineering schematic diagram with ESP32-S3 microcontroller, Sensirion SCD40 CO2 sensor, and solar battery charging IC.
content:
# AirSpark Sensor Hub - Rev C Electrical Architecture

- MCU: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 (16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM)
- CO2 Sensor: Sensirion SCD40 Photoacoustic sensor (I2C 0x62)
- Temp/Humidity: SHT40 (I2C 0x44)
- PM2.5/PM10: Plantower PMS7003 via UART2
- Power: 2500mAh LiFePO4 with TP4056 + Solar input range 4.5V-9.0V

title: Equipment Check-Out & Asset Care Protocol
author: Aisha Patel
description: Standard operating procedure for checking out projectors, laptops, and lab tools. Defines 7-day max checkout limit and condition reporting.
content:
# EcoSpark Innovations - Equipment Management Policy

1. **Always Log Check-Outs:** No item may leave the storage cabinet without logging the borrower in the EcoSpark Hub.
2. **Default Checkout Duration:** 7 calendar days. Extensions must be renewed in the portal.
3. **Condition Checks:** Return items in clean condition and report any worn components immediately.

title: Classroom Web Hub REST API Specification
author: Marcus Brody
description: Technical documentation for internal endpoints (/api/inventory, /api/documents, /api/stats, /api/activity) with request/response schemas.
content:
# EcoSpark REST API Specification

All endpoints return JSON responses with standardized envelope: `{ success: true, data: [...] }`.

### Endpoints:
- `GET /api/inventory` - Search & filter equipment
- `POST /api/inventory/:id/checkout` - Check out gear
- `POST /api/inventory/:id/checkin` - Return gear to available stock
- `GET /api/documents` - Search & explore files by folder
- `GET /api/stats` - Live KPIs
